sql: select 'xos_experiments_by_origin' as k, coalesce(origin,'(null)') as a, count(*)::text as b, ''::text as c from experiments group by 1,2 union all select 'evo_experiments', status, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from evo_experiments group by 1,2 union all select 'evo_tickets', status, count(*)::text, '' from evo_tickets group by 1,2 union all select 'degraded_reasons_7d', left(coalesce(failure_reason,'(none)'),40), count(*)::text, '' from evo_heartbeats where status='degraded' and created_at > now() - interval '7 days' group by 1,2 order by 1,2
